text: Before GitHub requires the gate (D-0075), D-0079's skip for docs moves from the workflow's trigger into the gate job. GitHub leaves a required check pending when path filtering skips its workflow, so a pull request that changes only docs could never merge. A job skipped by its own condition counts as passing. A factory pull request always runs the gate, since the factory merges only on a gate that passed. The change lands by pull request once CI runs again, and a docs-only pull request right after it shows the skip.
